description: Todos, which Epicenter bundles, runs in one window per folder, labelled todos:<folder name in hex>. The shell registers and hands each window its one folder before the window exists, and the page opens it with the folder plugin and listens for its change event, epicenter-folder://changed. Todos calls no account, AI, history, or app command. Its page is served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561).
